qe: A circular copper plate is heated, and its radius increases by 3.2%. What is the approximate percentage increase in its area?
qh: तांबे की एक वृत्ताकार प्लेट को गर्म किया जाता है, और इसकी त्रिज्या में 3.2% की वृद्धि होती है। इसके क्षेत्रफल में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Successive Percentage Formula):
Circle ka area $= \pi r^2$, yaani $\text{Area} \propto r^2$. Radius me do baar change count hoga.
Net Change $= a + b + \frac{ab}{100}$
Yahan $a = 3.2\%$ aur $b = 3.2\%$:
$= 3.2 + 3.2 + \frac{3.2 \times 3.2}{100} = 6.4 + 0.1024 = 6.5024\% \approx 6.50\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  6.50% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial area $= 100$ maan lo.
Radius factor $= 1 + \frac{3.2}{100} = 1.032$.
New Area $= 100 \times (1.032)^2 = 100 \times 1.065024 = 106.5024$.
Area me percentage badhav $= 106.5024 - 100 \approx 6.50\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '6.50%' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the surface area of a sphere increases by 96%, by what approximate percent does the radius increase?
qh: यदि एक गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 96% बढ़ जाता है, तो इसकी त्रिज्या में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Sphere ka surface area $= 4\pi r^2 \implies \text{Area} \propto r^2$.
Area $96\%$ badh gaya:
Initial Area : New Area $= 100 : (100 + 96) = 100 : 196$.
Radius ka ratio lene ke liye square root nikaalo:
Initial Radius : New Radius $= \sqrt{100} : \sqrt{196} = 10 : 14 = 5 : 7$.
Radius me badhav $= 7 - 5 = 2$ units (5 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{2}{5} \times 100\% = 40\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  40% hai.

Method 2 (Successive Check Method):
Agar radius $40\%$ badhegi, toh successive rule se:
$= 40 + 40 + \frac{40 \times 40}{100} = 80 + 16 = 96\%$.
Yeh question ke data se perfectly match karta hai, isliye answer 40% hai.
Atah sahi uttar '40%' hai.

qe: If the radius of a sphere is increased by 6%, then by what percentage will the surface area of the sphere increase?
qh: यदि एक गोले की त्रिज्या में 6% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो गोले के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Successive Formula):
Surface Area $\propto r^2$.
Formula: $x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$
Yahan $x = 6\%$ aur $y = 6\%$:
$= 6 + 6 + \frac{6 \times 6}{100} = 12 + 0.36 = 12.36\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  12.36% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
$6\% = \frac{3}{50}$.
Radius ratio $= 50 : 53$.
Area ratio $= 50^2 : 53^2 = 2500 : 2809$.
Increase $= 2809 - 2500 = 309$ units.
Percentage increase $= \frac{309}{2500} \times 100\% = \frac{309}{25}\% = 12.36\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '12.36%' hai.

Radius ratio $= 20 : (20 + 3) = 20 : 23$.

Increase in area $= 529 - 400 = 129$ units.

qe: The breadth of a rectangular field is decreased by 12% and its length is increased by 25%. Find the percentage change in the area of the field.
qh: एक आयताकार मैदान की चौड़ाई में 12% की कमी की जाती है और इसकी लंबाई में 25% की वृद्धि की जाती है। मैदान के क्षेत्रफल में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Length: $25\% = \frac{1}{4} \implies 4 : 5$.
Breadth: $12\% = \frac{3}{25} \implies 25 : 22$.
Area $=$ Length $\times$ Breadth.
Initial Area : New Area $= (4 \times 25) : (5 \times 22) = 100 : 110$.
Area 100 se badhkar 110 hua, yaani seedhe $10\%$ increase.
Atah sahi vikalp  10% increase hai.

Method 2 (Successive Formula):
Formula: $x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$
Yahan $x = +25$ aur $y = -12$:
$= 25 - 12 + \frac{25 \times (-12)}{100} = 13 - 3 = +10\%$ (10% increase).
Atah sahi uttar '10% increase' hai.

qe: The radius of a circle is increased in such a way that its circumference increases by 11%. As a result, the area of the circle also increases by:
qh: एक वृत्त की त्रिज्या इस प्रकार बढ़ाई जाती है कि उसकी परिधि में 11% की वृद्धि होती है। परिणामस्वरूप, वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Successive Formula):
Circumference $C = 2\pi r$, isliye circumference aur radius dono me same rate ($11\%$) se badhav hoga.
Area $\propto r^2$ hone ki wajah se successive change lagega:
$= 11 + 11 + \frac{11 \times 11}{100} = 22 + 1.21 = 23.21\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  23.21% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial area $= 100$.
New Area $= 100 \times \left(\frac{111}{100}\right) \times \left(\frac{111}{100}\right) = \frac{12321}{100} = 123.21$.
Increase over base $100 = 123.21 - 100 = 23.21\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '23.21%' hai.

qe: The radius of a circular wire is reduced by 5%. What is the percentage decrease in its cross-sectional area?
qh: एक वृत्ताकार तार की त्रिज्या में 5% की कमी की जाती है। इसके अनुप्रस्थ काट (cross-sectional) के क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी होगी?

Area $\propto r^2$.
Yahan $x = -5\%$ aur $y = -5\%$:
Net Change $= -5 - 5 + \frac{(-5) \times (-5)}{100} = -10 + 0.25 = -9.75\%$ (9.75% decrease).

Method 2 (Ratio Method):

Radius ratio $= 20 : 19$.
Area ratio $= 20^2 : 19^2 = 400 : 361$.
Area me kami $= 400 - 361 = 39$ units.
Percentage decrease $= \frac{39}{400} \times 100\% = \frac{39}{4}\% = 9.75\%$.

qe: If all three dimensions of a cuboid are increased by 15%, the volume increases by what percentage?
qh: यदि एक घनाभ की तीनों विमाओं में 15% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो आयतन में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
$15\% = \frac{3}{20}$.
Teeno dimensions ka ratio $= 20 : 23$.
Volume $= l \times b \times h$.
Initial Volume : New Volume $= 20^3 : 23^3 = 8000 : 12167$.
Volume me increase $= 12167 - 8000 = 4167$ units.
Percentage increase $= \frac{4167}{8000} \times 100\% = \frac{4167}{80}\% = 52.0875\% \approx 52.09\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  52.09% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial Volume $= 100$.
Pehle do dimensions ka net increase: $15 + 15 + \frac{15 \times 15}{100} = 30 + 2.25 = 32.25\%$.
Ab $32.25\%$ aur teesri dimension ($15\%$) ka net increase:
$= 32.25 + 15 + \frac{32.25 \times 15}{100} = 47.25 + 4.8375 = 52.0875\% \approx 52.09\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '52.09%' hai.

qe: The base of a triangle is increased by 25%. By what percentage should its height be increased so that the area increases by 75%?
qh: एक त्रिभुज के आधार में 25% की वृद्धि की जाती है। इसकी ऊंचाई में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि की जानी चाहिए ताकि क्षेत्रफल में 75% की वृद्धि हो जाए?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Area of triangle $= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} \implies \text{Height} = \frac{\text{Area}}{\text{Base}}$.
Base ratio: $25\% = \frac{1}{4} \implies 4 : 5$.
Area ratio: $75\% = \frac{3}{4} \implies 4 : 7$.
Height ratio $= \frac{4}{4} : \frac{7}{5} = 1 : 1.4 = 5 : 7$.
Height me increase $= 7 - 5 = 2$ units (5 ke base par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{2}{5} \times 100\% = 40\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  40% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial Area $= 100$.
Base $25\%$ badhne ke baad area ho jayega $= 125$.
Target area $= 175$ (total increase $75\%$).
Height ki wajah se required increase $= 175 - 125 = 50$.
125 ke base par percentage increase:
$= \frac{50}{125} \times 100\% = \frac{2}{5} \times 100\% = 40\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '40%' hai.

qe: If the height of a cylinder is increased by 20% and its radius is decreased by 10%, what is the percentage change in its volume?

Method 1 (Ratio Method):

Radius ($10\%$ decrease $= \frac{1}{10}$): ratio $= 10 : 9$.
Height ($20\%$ increase $= \frac{1}{5}$): ratio $= 5 : 6$.
Initial Volume : New Volume $= (10^2 \times 5) : (9^2 \times 6) = 500 : 486$.
Volume me kami $= 500 - 486 = 14$ units (500 ke base par).
Percentage decrease $= \frac{14}{500} \times 100\% = 2.8\%$ decrease.
Atah sahi vikalp  2.8% decrease hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Radius me do baar $10\%$ kami ka net effect: $-10 - 10 + \frac{(-10)(-10)}{100} = -19\%$.
Ab $-19\%$ aur height ke $+20\%$ ka net change:
$= -19 + 20 + \frac{(-19) \times 20}{100} = 1 - 3.8 = -2.8\%$ (yaani 2.8% decrease).
Atah sahi uttar '2.8% decrease' hai.

qe: If the length and breadth of a cuboid are increased by 5% and 10%, respectively, while its height remains constant, then the percentage increase in its volume is:
qh: यदि एक घनाभ की लंबाई और चौड़ाई में क्रमशः 5% और 10% की वृद्धि की जाती है, जबकि उसकी ऊंचाई अपरिवर्तित रहती है, तो उसके आयतन में प्रतिशत वृद्धि क्या होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Height constant hai, isliye Volume $\propto \text{Length} \times \text{Breadth}$.
Length: $5\% = \frac{1}{20} \implies 20 : 21$.
Breadth: $10\% = \frac{1}{10} \implies 10 : 11$.
Volume ratio $= (20 \times 10) : (21 \times 11) = 200 : 231$.
Base ko 100 banane ke liye 2 se divide karo: $100 : 115.5$.
Volume me increase $= 115.5 - 100 = 15.5\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  15.50% hai.

Method 2 (Successive Formula):
Net Change $= x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$
Yahan $x = 5\%$ aur $y = 10\%$:
$= 5 + 10 + \frac{5 \times 10}{100} = 15 + 0.5 = 15.50\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '15.50%' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: A metallic conical vessel with base radius 12 cm and height 18 cm is uniformly heated, increasing all its dimensions by 20%. By how much percent does the volume increase?
qh: 12 सेमी आधार त्रिज्या और 18 सेमी ऊंचाई वाले एक शंक्वाकार धात्विक बर्तन को समान रूप से गर्म किया जाता है, जिससे इसकी सभी विमाओं में 20% की वृद्धि होती है। इसके आयतन में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Cone ka volume $V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$. Sabhi dimensions $20\%$ badh rahi hain, isliye actual measurements (12 cm aur 18 cm) par calculation depend nahi karegi.
$20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies$ Each dimension ratio $= 5 : 6$.
Volume ratio $= 5^3 : 6^3 = 125 : 216$.
Volume me increase $= 216 - 125 = 91$ units (125 par).
Percentage increase $= \frac{91}{125} \times 100\% = \frac{91 \times 4}{5}\% = 72.8\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  72.8% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial volume $= 100$.
Pehle do dimensions ka net: $20 + 20 + \frac{20 \times 20}{100} = 44\%$.
Ab $44\%$ aur teesri dimension ($20\%$) ka net:
$= 44 + 20 + \frac{44 \times 20}{100} = 64 + 8.8 = 72.8\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '72.8%' hai.

Exam point: rasayan ke niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Suresh owns a rectangular plot. Due to widening of a road near his plot, the length and breadth of his plot are reduced by 20% and 15%, respectively. What is the percentage decrease in the area of his plot?
qh: सुरेश के पास एक आयताकार भूखंड है। उसके भूखंड के पास एक सड़क के चौड़ीकरण के कारण, उसके भूखंड की लंबाई और चौड़ाई में क्रमशः 20% और 15% की कमी हो जाती है। उसके भूखंड के क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Length: $20\% = \frac{1}{5} \implies 5 : 4$.
Breadth: $15\% = \frac{3}{20} \implies 20 : 17$.
Area $=$ Length $\times$ Breadth.
Initial Area : New Area $= (5 \times 20) : (4 \times 17) = 100 : 68$.
Area 100 se ghatkar 68 ho gaya, isliye kami $= 100 - 68 = 32\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  32% hai.

Method 2 (Successive Formula):
Net Change $= x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$
Yahan $x = -20\%$ aur $y = -15\%$:
$= -20 - 15 + \frac{(-20) \times (-15)}{100} = -35 + 3 = -32\%$ (yaani 32% decrease).
Atah sahi uttar '32%' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The length and breadth of a cuboid are increased by 10% and 20%, respectively, while its height is reduced by 25%. What is the total percentage increase or decrease in the volume of the cuboid?
qh: एक घनाभ की लंबाई और चौड़ाई में क्रमशः 10% और 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है, जबकि इसकी ऊंचाई में 25% की कमी की जाती है। घनाभ के आयतन में कुल कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि या कमी होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Length ($+10\% = \frac{1}{10}$): ratio $= 10 : 11$.
Breadth ($+20\% = \frac{1}{5}$): ratio $= 5 : 6$.
Height ($-25\% = -\frac{1}{4}$): ratio $= 4 : 3$.
Volume $= l \times b \times h$.
Initial Volume : New Volume $= (10 \times 5 \times 4) : (11 \times 6 \times 3) = 200 : 198$.
Base 100 banane ke liye 2 se divide karo: $100 : 99$.
Volume 100 se 99 ho gaya, yaani $1\%$ ki kami (Decrease by 1%).
Atah sahi vikalp  Decrease by 1% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial Volume $= 100$.
Length aur breadth ka net increase: $10 + 20 + \frac{10 \times 20}{100} = 32\%$.
Ab $+32\%$ aur height ke $-25\%$ ka net change:
$= 32 - 25 + \frac{32 \times (-25)}{100} = 7 - 8 = -1\%$ (1% decrease).
Atah sahi uttar 'Decrease by 1%' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: Find the total percentage change in the volume of a cuboid if its length and breadth are decreased by 20% and 10%, respectively, while its height is increased by 50%.
qh: एक घनाभ के आयतन में कुल प्रतिशत परिवर्तन ज्ञात कीजिए यदि इसकी लंबाई और चौड़ाई में क्रमशः 20% और 10% की कमी की जाती है, जबकि इसकी ऊंचाई में 50% की वृद्धि की जाती है।
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Length ($-20\% = -\frac{1}{5}$): ratio $= 5 : 4$.
Breadth ($-10\% = -\frac{1}{10}$): ratio $= 10 : 9$.
Height ($+50\% = +\frac{1}{2}$): ratio $= 2 : 3$.
Initial Volume : New Volume $= (5 \times 10 \times 2) : (4 \times 9 \times 3) = 100 : 108$.
Volume 100 se badhkar 108 ho gaya, isliye net change $= 108 - 100 = 8\%$ increase.
Atah sahi vikalp  8% increase hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial Volume $= 100$.
Length aur breadth dono me kami ka net: $-20 - 10 + \frac{(-20)(-10)}{100} = -30 + 2 = -28\%$.
Ab $-28\%$ aur height ke $+50\%$ ka net change:
$= -28 + 50 + \frac{(-28) \times 50}{100} = 22 - 14 = +8\%$ (8% increase).
Atah sahi uttar '8% increase' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If the length and breadth of a cuboid are increased by 8% and 5%, respectively, while its height remains unchanged, then the percentage increase in its volume is:
qh: यदि एक घनाभ की लंबाई और चौड़ाई में क्रमशः 8% और 5% की वृद्धि की जाती है, जबकि उसकी ऊंचाई अपरिवर्तित रहती है, तो उसके आयतन में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Successive Formula):
Cuboid ka volume $V = l \times b \times h$. Yahan height constant hai, isliye volume me percentage badlav length aur breadth ke successive change ke barabar hoga:
Net Change $= a + b + \frac{ab}{100}$
Yahan $a = +8\%$ aur $b = +5\%$:
$= 8 + 5 + \frac{8 \times 5}{100} = 13 + 0.40 = 13.40\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  13.40% hai.

Method 2 (Ratio Method):
Length ($+8\% = \frac{2}{25}$): ratio $= 25 : 27$.
Breadth ($+5\% = \frac{1}{20}$): ratio $= 20 : 21$.
Volume ratio $= (25 \times 20) : (27 \times 21) = 500 : 567$.
Base ko 100 banane ke liye 5 se divide karo: $100 : 113.4$.
Volume me increase $= 113.4 - 100 = 13.4\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '13.40%' hai.

qe: If the height of a cylinder is decreased by 20% and its radius is increased by 20%, then the volume changes by:
qh: यदि एक बेलन की ऊंचाई 20% कम कर दी जाए और त्रिज्या 20% बढ़ा दी जाए, तो आयतन में कितना परिवर्तन होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Cylinder ka volume $V = \pi r^2 h \implies V \propto r \times r \times h$.
Radius ($+20\% = +\frac{1}{5}$): ratio $= 5 : 6$ (do baar apply hoga).
Height ($-20\% = -\frac{1}{5}$): ratio $= 5 : 4$.
Initial Volume : New Volume $= (5 \times 5 \times 5) : (6 \times 6 \times 4) = 125 : 144$.
Volume me increase $= 144 - 125 = 19$ units (125 ke base par).
Percentage change $= \frac{19}{125} \times 100\% = \frac{19 \times 4}{5}\% = 15.2\%$ increase.
Atah sahi vikalp  Increase by 15.2% hai.

Method 2 (Successive Formula):
Radius me do baar $20\%$ badhav ka net: $20 + 20 + \frac{20 \times 20}{100} = 44\%$.
Ab $+44\%$ aur height ke $-20\%$ ka net change:
$= 44 - 20 + \frac{44 \times (-20)}{100} = 24 - 8.8 = +15.2\%$ (Increase by 15.2%).
Atah sahi uttar 'Increase by 15.2%' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: The radius of a sphere is reduced by 20%. By what approximate percentage does the volume decrease?
qh: एक गोले की त्रिज्या 20% कम कर दी जाती है। आयतन में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की कमी होगी?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
Sphere ka volume $V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3 \implies V \propto r^3$.
Radius reduction $= 20\% = \frac{1}{5}$.
Initial Radius : New Radius $= 5 : (5 - 1) = 5 : 4$.
Volume ratio $= 5^3 : 4^3 = 125 : 64$.
Volume me kami $= 125 - 64 = 61$ units (125 ke base par).
Percentage decrease $= \frac{61}{125} \times 100\% = \frac{61 \times 4}{5}\% = \frac{244}{5}\% = 48.8\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  48.8% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial volume $= 100$.
Pehle do radius cut ka net: $-20 - 20 + \frac{(-20)(-20)}{100} = -40 + 4 = -36\%$.
Ab $-36\%$ aur teesre cut ($-20\%$) ka net:
$= -36 - 20 + \frac{(-36) \times (-20)}{100} = -56 + 7.2 = -48.8\%$ (yaani 48.8% decrease).
Atah sahi uttar '48.8%' hai.

Exam point: kshetrafal-aayatan ke sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If both the length and breadth of a cuboid are increased by 20%, then by how much percent (correct to two decimal places) should its height be reduced so that the volume of the cuboid remains the same?
qh: यदि एक घनाभ की लंबाई और चौड़ाई दोनों में 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है, तो इसकी ऊंचाई में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी की जानी चाहिए ताकि घनाभ का आयतन समान रहे?
e:
Method 1 (Ratio Method):
$\text{Volume} = \text{Base Area} \times \text{Height} = \text{Constant} \implies \text{Height} \propto \frac{1}{\text{Base Area}}$.
Length aur breadth dono $20\% (\frac{1}{5})$ badhe hain:
Base Area ratio $= (5 \times 5) : (6 \times 6) = 25 : 36$.
Volume unchanged rakhne ke liye height ka ratio ulta hoga:
Height ratio $= 36 : 25$.
Height me reduction $= 36 - 25 = 11$ units (36 ke base par).
Percentage reduction $= \frac{11}{36} \times 100\% = \frac{275}{9}\% \approx 30.56\%$.
Atah sahi vikalp  30.56% hai.

Method 2 (100-Base Method):
Initial base area $= 100$.
Length aur breadth badhne ke baad naya base area:
$= 20 + 20 + \frac{20 \times 20}{100} = 44\% \implies 144$.
Volume constant rakhne ke liye height ko 144 se ghata kar wapas 100 par laana hoga:
Reduction needed $= 144 - 100 = 44$.
144 ke base par percentage reduction:
$= \frac{44}{144} \times 100\% = \frac{11}{36} \times 100\% \approx 30.56\%$.
Atah sahi uttar '30.56%' hai.
